what: The declared split's ratio: the widened band measurement's six (file, language) cells re-measured with the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, plants, floors, block population and leave-one-out tables carried forward unchanged, and each side's counted pairs re-fold under the declared 25/75 block split, so the real is priced above the same band with the machinery's climb freedom shrunk to a quarter of each side's pairs. The bridge gate re-derived the frozen widened-band artifact's first cell through the standing split before the ratio cells ran. The declared truthful question: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when the climb part shrinks to a quarter of each side's pairs. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.split_rule: the counted pairs of each side, in stream order, split into contiguous blocks at the quarter mark: the first floor(N/4) pairs the climb part the machinery may search, the remaining pairs the score part it may never touch; the block fold's own first-block convention (the smaller share on a remainder) at one quarter of the pairs; the halves share no counted pair and every identity anchor's halves fold by the same rule; deterministic, consuming no seed
declared.loo_rule: the shape measurement's leave-one-out table carried forward unchanged: the inherited add-one form is log((n_ab + 1) / (N + 729)) with N the standing reference stream's total counted pairs; every pair type (a, b) present in the reference pair table is scored with one occurrence of (a, b) removed from the reference counts, log(n_ab / (N + 728)), and a type with no counted occurrence keeps the inherited add-one entry log(1 / (N + 729)); the letter marginals and rank initialisation unchanged, the matrix arithmetic needing no re-derivation as the shape measurement declared
declared.measured_facts_rule: the mapped set, streams, seeds, machinery, restarts, sweep cap, plants, floors, band population and reference texts are the held-out screen's, block-fold measurement's and widened band's declarations carried unchanged; the real, plants, floors and every band member's encodings are byte-identical replays of the frozen widened-band artifact's declared draws and only the split's ratio changes: every side's counted pairs re-fold at the quarter mark, every identity anchor's halves fold by the same rule, and the machinery re-climbs on the smaller climb part with ties to the first restart; each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision; each side's exact full-data side call is recorded beside its held-out value for attribution only
declared.machinery_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen: the exact greedy reassignment climb on the climb half, exact pricing on the score half, restart 0 the rank initialisation from the climb half, restarts 1 onward the seeded permutations of the 27 letter tokens under the wrap rule, the best restart the best exact climb-half total with ties to the first; no assignment is stored
declared.seed_sharing: no new seed kinds are consumed: the real, plants, floors and band members replay the declared draws from the declared kinds at the declared positions exactly as the frozen widened band consumed them, and the split consumes no seed; consuming none of any other module's declared draws
declared.bridge_gate: before the ratio cells run, the split-ratio instrument's full first cell (ZL english: the real, its five plants, its five floors and its seven widened band members) is computed through this measurement's code with the block fold's standing split supplied and compared field for field against the frozen widened-band artifact's own first cell; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.corpus_source_rule: no new corpus files: this measurement declares no candidates and records no corpus roster; the band population is the frozen widened band's declared roster and the references are the standing references' frozen files, all stored raw with their Gutenberg markers and processed by the standing declared processing
declared.band_record_rule: membership, selection, ties and spreads are declared unchanged from the held-out screen (a member's band value the held-out value of the draw whose exact climb-half total is best, strict beyond 1e-12, ties to the first draw); each member records draws_climb_exact, its five climb-half totals at full precision, so the declared selection is re-derivable from the stored artifact; membership unconditional: every band member enters the band under the ratio split exactly as under the block fold and no convergence criterion is applied to any member
declared.verdict_rule: unchanged from the held-out screen and applied to the split-ratio numbers: the real held-out at or above the smallest member band value is consistent-with-substitution, at or below the largest floor's held-out value is not-consistent, strictly between is below-held-band; the strings describe consistency under this artifact's declared split ratio and do not restate the widened band's verdicts
declared.margin_rule: the margin is computed from the stored rounded values: the real held-out mean minus the smallest member band value, rounded to four decimals
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a split-ratio verdict is split-geometry evidence and the widened band's verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.truthful_question: declared in advance: does the real's held-out score-half value still stand above the band when the climb part shrinks to a quarter of each side's counted pairs - a yes extends the separation to a smaller search freedom, a no records that the margin rode the climb half's size
